title: Medigap and QMB Shares in the Resident Funds Coinsurance Reserve
content:
In the coinsurance run-up reserved against an ancillary per-bill authorization amount on a Resident Trust Fund Accounts account, each coinsurance day is reserved at the share the supplemental coverage sets. That share follows the supplemental coverage on the resident's active episode under Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage:

| Supplemental coverage on the episode | Share percent of a coinsurance day reserved |
|---|---|
| Medigap Plan K, with no QMB status | the Plan K resident share, 50 percent |
| Medigap Plan L, with no QMB status | the Plan L resident share, 25 percent |
| a full-coinsurance Medigap plan (C, D, F, G, M or N), or QMB status | nothing, 0 percent |
| any other case | the whole coinsurance, 100 percent |

## Combinations

| Medigap plan letter | QMB status | Share |
|---|---|---|
| K | none | 50 percent |
| K | on file | 0 percent |
| L | none | 25 percent |
| L | on file | 0 percent |
| G | none | 0 percent |
| none, or A or B | none | 100 percent |
| none | on file | 0 percent |

## Hypothetical illustration

Three coinsurance days at $209.50 a day reserve $628.50 at 100 percent, $314.25 at the Plan K share, $157.125 at the Plan L share (no rounding is applied to the reserve itself) and nothing for a resident with QMB status.
